Pranayama.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine

Pranayama.fact: Pranayama (Sanskrit: प्राणायाम, "Prāṇāyāma") is the yogic practice of controlling the breath in Hinduism.

Pranayama.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine

Pranayama.fact: Tibetan Buddhist breathing exercises such as the "nine breathings of purification" or the "Ninefold Expulsion of Stale Vital Energy" (rlung ro dgu shrugs), a form of alternate nostril breathing, commonly include visualizations.

Pranayama.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine

Pranayama.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Pranayama.question: Later, in _____ yoga texts, it meant the complete suspension of breathing
Pranayama.fact: Later, in Hatha yoga texts, it meant the complete suspension of breathing. The pranayama practices in modern yoga as exercise, such as in Ashtanga (vinyasa) yoga, differ radically from those of the Hatha yoga tradition, often using the breath in synchrony with movements.

Pranayama.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Pranayama.question: Monier-_____ defines the compound prāṇāyāma as "of the three 'breath-exercises' performed during Saṃdhyā (See pūrak, rechak (English: retch or throw out), kumbhak"
Pranayama.fact: Monier-Williams defines the compound prāṇāyāma as "of the three 'breath-exercises' performed during Saṃdhyā (See pūrak, rechak (English: retch or throw out), kumbhak".

Pranayama.fact: The first three meanings have to do with "length", "expansion, extension", and "stretching, extending", but in the specific case of use in the compound prāṇāyāma he defines āyāmaḥ as meaning "restrain, control, stopping". Pranayama.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine

Pranayama.fact: For instance, a 1956 study by Kuvalayananda and Karambelkar sought to find out what happened to the acidity of the urine following prolonged bhastrika pranayama.

Pranayama.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine

Pranayama.fact: For example, a 2018 systematic review by Andrea Zaccaro and colleagues examined 2,461 research articles on the effects of pranayama and breath control more generally on the cardio-respiratory system and the central nervous system.

Praxis School.fact: The group also organized the widely popular Korčula Summer School in the island of Korčula.

Praxis School.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Praxis School.question: Leninist and _____ theories were considered to be unfaithful to the Marxist theory, as they were adjusted according to the needs of the party elite and intolerant of ideological criticism

Pre-Anuradhapura period.question: According to the _____, the original inhabitants of Sri Lanka are the Yakshas and northern Naga tribes

Pre-Anuradhapura period.fact: According to the Mahavamsa, the original inhabitants of Sri Lanka are the Yakshas and northern Naga tribes. Some recorded naga settlements in Sri Lanka were Kelaniya and the modern-day Jaffna Peninsula.

Pre-Anuradhapura period.fact: According to Mahavamsa, the legendary Prince Vijaya and seven hundred of his followers came to Sri Lanka after being expelled from Sinhapura in India.
